Re:        PJM Interconnection L.L.C., Docket Nos. EL25-49-000 and -001
           Second Supplemental Informational Report

Dear Secretary Reese:

           As referenced in the February 23, 2026 supplemental informational report, 1 PJM

Interconnection, L.L.C. (“PJM”) submits this second supplemental informational filing to update

the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (“Commission”) regarding the timeline for

stakeholder deliberation on the reliability backstop procurement mechanism.

      I.      INFORMATIONAL FILING

           Since the February 23, 2026 supplemental informational report, PJM has continued to

discuss the framework of a reliability backstop procurement mechanism with stakeholders.

Through these stakeholder workshops, PJM heard from various stakeholders on potential options

and pitfalls associated with various reliability backstop procurement mechanisms. Based on the

discussions to date, PJM plans to develop a comprehensive reliability backstop proposal for

stakeholder consideration by mid-April.             Accordingly, while PJM is working to develop a

 Honorable Debbie-Anne A. Reese, Secretary

comprehensive proposal to present to stakeholders in a future Reliability Backstop Procurement

Workshop meeting, PJM will not be hosting another meeting until April.

        Upon resumption of the Reliability Backstop Procurement Workshop meetings, PJM

expects to review PJM’s proposal with stakeholders and will be open to additional feedback,

including alternative proposals, before finalizing a package with stakeholders by the end of May.

This timeline will continue to allow PJM to implement the reliability backstop procurement before

the end of this year.

        II.     CONCLUSION

        PJM pledges to keep the Commission informed of the timeline for submission of a filing

to the Commission if changes to the current timeline become necessary. PJM appreciates the

Commission and stakeholders’ dedication and engagement on this matter.

                                                    Respectfully submitted,
